why.max_prompt_tokens: The operator's decision, 2026-10-28 (C2048): 27,000 by the provider's own count, re-derived from real tokens once the gateway counted them (C1898): the largest recorded Explain request was 26,053 real tokens (958 calls); 20,000, written against the 3-characters-a-token under-estimate, refused 5 of the 21 recorded alerts on every run. Under Sonnet 5.5's long tier (200,000).
why.max_tokens: Measured (C1754, C1757's rule): about 2.5x the largest output of 65 calls, 2,286 tokens (Sonnet 5.5, adaptive thinking included; the recorded cases 1 to 7 on v4 and 2 to 7 on v5, five runs each, 2026-10-26 03:23 to 03:42 UTC, under the provisional 8,192, none stopped at it). 1,024 had truncated 50 of 60 calls in v5's first proof. A call is billed for what it uses; the bound sets only the per-call cap.
